title: Personal Loans Fee Waiver Guidelines: Bases, Courtesy Allowance and Request Window
content:
## Guidelines in force

Each Personal Loans fee can be waived at most once. A courtesy waiver is granted on the borrower's request when the loan had at least the grade's minimum number of on-time installments in the 12 months before the fee was assessed and fewer than the grade's courtesy waivers per 12 months have already been granted on the loan. For courtesy and documented bank error waivers, the waiver is requested no later than the fee waiver request window after the fee's assessment date. The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the fee's assessment date, and a request on the last day of the window is in time. A documented bank error waiver needs a letter from the borrower's bank stating the return was the bank's error.

A lender error waiver applies whenever a Larkspur error (a duplicate debit, a debit on the wrong date or for the wrong amount, or a payment posted late by Larkspur) caused the fee, with no window or count limit, and an unauthorized debit waiver applies to any fee arising from a debit the payments team has confirmed was not authorized. Fees on a loan whose borrower has an approved hardship assistance plan, an active Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit or an active Disaster Relief Deferral are waived as hardship relief, servicemember benefit or disaster relief under the hardship program rules. Waivers on these other bases never use up the courtesy allowance. When a fee qualifies on more than one basis, the first basis in the order lender error, unauthorized debit, documented bank error, servicemember benefit, disaster relief, hardship relief, courtesy is recorded.

How the counts are read:

- **On-time installments in the 12 months before the fee**: installment due dates in the 12 calendar months ending on the day before the fee's assessment date, each paid in full (amounts credited toward it, net of any later-returned payment, reaching the scheduled payment amount) no later than the end of the late-fee grace period, with no late fee charged for it.
- **Courtesy waivers already granted**: courtesy waivers on the loan dated today or in the 364 days before it.

## Clause no longer in force for one fee

The clause below is no longer in force for a courtesy waiver of the latest late fee charged on the loan (on a tie of dates, the first one recorded) while no fee payment has posted against it, whose amount waived is set under the current courtesy amount rule, never more than that fee's amount less every earlier waiver line applied to it. Every other fee, an earlier late fee, a returned-payment fee and a latest late fee a fee payment has already reached included, remains under it:

> A late fee or returned-payment fee may be waived only on one of the bases above, one waiver line per fee, for the part of the fee still unpaid (a fee already paid in full is not waived; a refund of a paid fee is outside these guidelines).

## Request window (60-day window, hypothetical dates)

| Fee assessed | Last day to request | Request on that day | Request the day after |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 30 April | in time | late |
| 15 July | 13 September | in time | late |

## Basis order (hypothetical)

A fee caused by a Larkspur duplicate debit, on a loan whose borrower also asks for courtesy, is recorded as lender error and does not use up the courtesy allowance.
